per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available 99.99% of the time excluding catastrophic full-server-farm failures.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: About 90% of user tasks shall complete within 5 seconds and almost all tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support at least 1,000 simultaneous requests at launch and scale to 2,000 simultaneous requests in the next release without service degradation for core booking functions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Authentication shall be restricted to company employees and vetted external users with company-approved IDs; anonymous accounts are not permitted.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate with the corporate identity system (SSO) via a standard connector so authentication is tied to the corporate identity process.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product's Look and Feel shall be able to incorporate aspects of the customer's organization such as logo branding and identity'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall log access attempts (successful and failed) for audit purposes and make those logs available to the company's risk/compliance teams.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall reliably send email invites, reminders, and cancellations and support integration with multiple email server types/vendors used by different offices.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall capture exception records (not only logs) that can be packaged and made available/transmitted to the company's analysis teams on a regular basis.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product's UI shall support incorporation of the company's branding (logo, colors, look-and-feel) to make it feel part of the corporate ecosystem.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product's Look and Feel shall be able to incorporate aspects of the customer's organization such as logo branding and identity'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide user-selectable language support; a language selection mechanism must exist and target languages will be prioritized per release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall conform to applicable accessibility requirements (e.g., ADA) and not exclude users with disabilities.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall run in standard HTML browsers without requiring plugins and shall render correctly across a representative test matrix of at least 8 browsers and at least 80% of browsers tested.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Under extreme load the system shall prioritize and keep core booking and availability-check flows responsive; non-essential work may be shed to preserve snappy booking behavior.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall validate imported data (e.g., spreadsheet imports) to prevent phantom or corrupt bookings and shall provide tools to quickly detect and clean erroneous import artifacts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure reliable notification delivery (email invites/reminders) to prevent missed meetings, with monitoring/alerts for failed deliveries.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be perceived as low-friction and simple to use (booking and running meetings should be 'boring'—no surprises or fiddly back-and-forth).
